strings.en:
{0b:08}【 Middle-Aged Mercenary 】{0b:09}
We fought 'em fair and square and sent
'em runnin' in a rout.{1a}The master of this castle,
{10}-sama, is no ordinary fighter.
His wife Sara-sama's got a pretty face,
and the nerve to go with it.{1a}Three thousand men comin' at 'em, and
neither of 'em so much as flinched.{1a}Sara-sama, she tells the kids 'I'll be right
back, okay?' with that same smile
as always,{1a}and walks out like she's goin' off
to market.{1a}The fight was over in about thirty
minutes. In the end we lost nobody. The
other side, you couldn't bear to look.{1a}Mind you, {10}-sama said that was
holdin' back.{0c:2b5409fe}

In the end we lost nobody. The other side, you couldn't bear to look. // Mind you, [HERO]-sama said that was holdin' back.
[HERO]-sama's that strong, huh... // [1]That easy smile nearly had me fooled. Better not make him mad...

strings.en:
{0b:08}【 Middle-Aged Mercenary 】{0b:09}
Well, one way and another, nobody
attacks this castle anymore.{1a}Stands to reason. Two people who can
whip three thousand... nobody's fool
enough to pick a fight with a couple
like that.{1a}What's more, other countries' armies
don't even march through around here
now. That's why this whole area's
at peace.{1a}In a world covered in thick cloud, I guess
you'd call it the one spot where the light
gets through.{0c:2b5409fe}

That's why this whole area's at peace. // In a world covered in thick cloud, I guess you'd call it the one spot where the light gets through.
Wow, that's somethin'... // By the way, I heard the kids go up by dozens every month. Is the money holdin' out?

strings.en:
{0b:08}【 Middle-Aged Mercenary 】{0b:09}
We fought 'em fair and square and sent
'em runnin' in a rout.{1a}The two mistresses of this castle,
{10}-sama and Sara-sama, are no
ordinary fighters.{1a}Three thousand men comin' at 'em, and
neither of 'em so much as flinched.{1a}Sara-sama, she tells the kids 'I'll be right
back, okay?' with that same smile
as always,{1a}and walks out like she's goin' off

minutes. In the end we lost nobody. The
other side, you couldn't bear to look.{1a}Mind you, {10}-sama said that was
holdin' back.{0c:2b5409fe}

strings.en:
{0b:08}【 Middle-Aged Mercenary 】{0b:09}
Well, one way and another, nobody
attacks this castle anymore.{1a}Stands to reason. Two people who can
whip three thousand... nobody's fool
enough to pick a fight with lords
like that.{1a}What's more, other countries' armies
don't even march through around here
now. That's why this whole area's
at peace.{1a}In a world covered in thick cloud, I guess
you'd call it the one spot where the light
gets through.{0c:2b5409fe}

Two people who can whip three thousand... nobody's fool enough to pick a fight with lords like that. // What's more, other countries' armies don't even march through around here now. That's why this whole area's at peace. // In a world covered in thick cloud, I guess you'd call it the one spot where the light gets through.
Wow, that's somethin'... // By the way, I heard the kids go up by dozens every month. Is the money holdin' out?
